rows.traditional: 將 A 埋喺 B 入面
rows.jyutping: zoeng1 A maai4 hai2 B jap6 min6
rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose choice when something is surrounded by clay, mortar, sand, or another material.

example.english: We embed the wire in the wall, then cover it with cement.
example.traditional: 我將條電線埋喺牆入面，外面再鋪水泥。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 tiu4 din6 sin3 maai4 hai2 coeng4 jap6 min6 ngoi6 min6 zoi3 pou1 seoi2 nai4

rows.note: Use this technical term when placing a chart, video, or other content inside a document or data file.

example.english: You can embed the video in the report without opening a separate link.
example.traditional: 你可以將條片嵌入份報告，唔使另外開個連結。
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 tiu4 pin3 ham6 jap6 fan6 bou3 gou3 m4 sai2 ling6 ngoi6 hoi1 go3 lin4 git3
